s: The early Chalukyas worshipped this mother goddess?
x:
The Early Chalukyas were devotees of the goddess Cushmandini (Kushmandini), who was revered as a mother goddess and is also associated with Jain religious traditions. Inscriptions and historical records indicate that the worship of Cushmandini was prevalent among the early Chalukyas before the later dominance of Shaivism and Vaishnavism.
Hence, the correct answer is
Option (1).
